items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Gosden and them were very good friends of mine.

ctx.x: So we used to go out, the studio would send a driver for us. Come out -- because that's a long ways out to Hollywood from Central Avenue. We had to go out early. So we were riding around, riding around. And you know, the car stopped -- the bus stops in California, they sit on the side. So we were riding along and I'm sitting at the window and I lean out and just said to women going to work, "Hi, Sue."

Right away Duke say, "Man, that's a title for a song." And he wrote it. "Hi, Sue." We recorded it. "Hi, Sue." That's right. So we get on the set and we were making -- you know, we were making this Amos and Andy thing first and they were --(Freeman and) Gosden and them were very good friends of mine. And so they said, "Hey, Sonny, how you feel?" I said, "Terrible". They said, "Come on, Man, we have a little taste on after work."
What were some songs from that picture?
